BBC Prison Drama 'Time' Season 3 Receives Critical Acclaim

The third and final season of the BBC prison drama 'Time' has garnered critical praise, with reviewers highlighting its scintillating and urgent television. Actor David Tennant's performance in the series has been singled out as Bafta-worthy, and the show has prompted reflection on the realities of the prison system.
